title: Pre-Nursing Careers Night
description: Learn about different healthcare jobs and career paths from people with experience in the field. We’ll hear about what different roles are actually like, what education they require, and about local job opportunities

title: Astronomy Documentary Watch Party
description:
We found a bunch of old astronomy DVDs in the Astronomy Library, so we're going to watch them!* We will get together weekly in the planetarium to watch one DVD and have a discussion afterwards on how well the science has held up.

*The copyright office has informed us that we can play these DVDs at club activities as long as we a) don't charge money and b) have a lecture and/or discussion before or after.

title: ExDM Application Night
description: Pre-students can come and dive deeper into the application process and receive advice on their essays and résumés. We will share tips and tricks on the application, and then students will have time to meet with a mentor and receive one-on-one advice.

title: Clash Royale Club Summer Kickoff
description:
The arena is open.

Join us for the Clash Royale Club Summer Kickoff and meet other BYU students who enjoy the game, whether you're pushing ladder, grinding Path of Legends, or just looking for people who understand the pain of losing to Hog 2.6 for the fifth time in a row.

We'll have food, casual games, friendly battles, and a club tournament with **$100 in prizes** up for grabs. It's a great chance to make friends, find new clanmates, test your decks, and enjoy some competition in a fun, welcoming environment.

No matter your trophy count or skill level, everyone is welcome. Come for the food, stay for the battles, and maybe leave with a prize and some new friends.

See you in the arena.
